title: An Elegant Puzzle
author: Will Larson
note: Started it in 2026. It’s from the past, but it’s still useful today.

title: The Manager's Path
author: Camille Fournier
note: Not my favourite. It felt quite typical.

title: Accelerate
author: Nicole Forsgren, Jez Humble, Gene Kim
note: A must. Psychological safety is key for successful teams. Hoping the second edition arrives soon.

title: Team Topologies
author: Matthew Skelton, Manuel Pais
note: When you need to think about how to structure a team, there’s useful advice here.

title: Radical Candor
author: Kim Scott
note: The basics are good, but only part of the book was useful to me.

title: Building effective agents
author: Anthropic
note: A good reminder that simple beats clever. Start with the smallest thing that works and only add agents when it pays off.

title: Maker's Schedule, Manager's Schedule
author: Paul Graham
note: Old, but still true. One meeting in the middle of the afternoon can break a whole day of deep work.
